name: Frustum Raycasting and Blending
definition: A post-processing step that casts rays from the camera through each pixel, intersects them with a cloud volume bounding box, and blends the resulting cloud color with the original scene color.
summary: Frustum Raycasting and Blending is a screen-space post-processing technique that casts rays through pixels to intersect cloud volumes, blending results with scene color to fix transparency artifacts and occlusion issues.
